title: Student Admission Consulting
intro: We help international students gain admission to top Chinese universities. From selecting the right program to submitting applications and obtaining student visas, Nadoumi Consulting supports every step of your academic journey.

steps.title: Program Selection
steps.description: We assess your academic background and recommend the best universities and programs in China.

steps.title: Document Preparation
steps.description: We guide you in preparing and uploading all required documents including transcripts, recommendation letters, and passport copies.

steps.title: Application Submission
steps.description: We handle the application submission process and track your progress with university admissions offices.

steps.title: Visa & Pre-departure
steps.description: We assist with student visa procedures, pre-departure guidance, and post-arrival registration.

cta.heading: Ready to Study in China?
cta.text: Submit your application online and let our experts guide you through admission and visa processing.
